description.value:
You create light, medium, or heavy armor out of junk that you immediately don. You lose the benefits of any armor you were already wearing when you cast this spell, including any upgrades in that armor. You can create any common commercial grade armor, and it gains the noisy and tech traits if it doesn't have them already. It can't be made of any special materials.

The armor has one fewer upgrade slot than usual. When you Cast this Spell, you can automatically Install any upgrades you're holding in your hands as a locus into any upgrade slots the armor has.

Heightened (2nd) You can create tactical armor.

Heightened (5th) You can create advanced armor.

Heightened (6th) You can create superior armor.

Heightened (8th) You can create elite armor.

Heightened (9th) You can create ultimate armor.

Heightened (10th) You can create paragon armor.
